view: Frontal chest radiograph (PA/AP, erect), no clear R/L marker; a small external label at the image upper-right (not an R/L marker) - conventional orientation assumed
technical_quality: Adequate. Inspiration adequate (about 8-9 posterior ribs visible), mild patient rotation, slight underpenetration of the mediastinum; lung apices and both costophrenic angles included. No lines, tubes, pacemaker or surgical clips.

abnormalities.finding: Increased coarse bronchovascular / interstitial markings with a mild reticular pattern in the perihilar and lower zones, slightly more prominent on the right; suggests mild interstitial edema versus chronic bronchitic/interstitial change
Prominent hila with mildly prominent central vascular markings
Prominent aortic knob with unfolded/tortuous thoracic aorta (age-related)
Cardiac silhouette at the upper limit of normal (CTR approximately 0.45-0.5), borderline cardiomegaly
Relative hyperlucency of the upper zones with slightly attenuated peripheral vessels, possible mild emphysematous change
Degenerative changes of both glenohumeral joints and the thoracic spine
Dense, protuberant upper abdomen (large body habitus / abdominal distension) elevating the hemidiaphragms slightly

description_zh: 正面胸部X光，吸氣尚可、患者略有旋轉，未見任何管路、導線、節律器或手術夾。雙側肺門周圍及下肺野支氣管血管紋理增粗並呈輕度網狀，右側略明顯，疑為輕度間質性肺水腫或慢性支氣管／間質性變化；上肺野相對透亮，周邊血管略稀疏。心影大小約在正常上限，主動脈弓突出且胸主動脈迂曲，符合老年變化；雙側肋膈角銳利，未見氣胸或明顯肋膜積液。骨骼見雙肩關節及胸椎退化性變化，上腹部密度增高、腹部膨隆。
